notes.title: Praetorians - HD Remaster Update v.1.04 has been released!
notes.content:
Legionnaires,
We’ve been hard at work on Praetorians - HD Remaster’s next update (1.04) and we’re excited to share the details with you below.

[h3]General fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a number of text and localization issues
[*] Added performance optimization for larger-scale battles
[*] Fixed issue where UI options would highlight for non-applicable troop types
[*] Added focus border around text input field when using a controller
[*] Fixed a few crash-causing bugs
[*] Fixed bug where left/right arrow key would adjust sequence playback speed
[*] Fixed Barbarian War Chariot t-posing in 'Fear the Eagles‘ mission[/list]

[h3]Multiplayer fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Improved flow when exiting multiplayer sessions
[*] Made change so that if host leaves game after gameplay is complete, client now maintains end game result instead of displaying 'undefeated'
[*] Fixed issue transitioning to multiplayer if 'Join Game‘ option fails
[*] Added scrolling function to chat box on lobby screen
[*] Fixed unnecessary client connection error pop-up after creating a saved sequence[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.03 of Praetorians - HD Remaster has been released!
notes.content:
Legionnaires,

Thank you for all your great feedback. 

We’ve been hard at work on Praetorians - HD Remaster’s next update (1.03) and we’re excited to share the details with you below:

[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed a crash when hovering over multi-troop health bar and the troop dies.
[*] Fixed a crash with video options screen not setting a correct index on the initial load of a game.
[*] Measures to avoid crashes, if a unit that is not intended to be on a wall, still getting on a wall.
[*] Fixed various stability issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where troops without a 'wall' formation were able to be loaded into an Assault Tower.
[*] Fixed an issue with the difficulty level appearing different to what it had been set.
[*] Fixed a flicker on the names during the ‘Skirmish complete’ screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with resolution options not saving.
[*] Fixed issue with volume settings not being saved.
[*] Fixed issue with camera movement when both mouse + controller is attached and a controller is assigned as Player 2, 3 or 4. 
[*] Fixed an issue with backing out of the settings screen and new settings not saving.[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] [Multiplayer] Fixed camera reset for all connected players when a player leaves multiplayer.
[*] [Multiplayer] Fixed clients not being notified of other clients disconnecting.
[*] [Multiplayer] When the host leaves a game, clients now receive a message that makes them automatically leave the game
[*] [Multiplayer] When the host leaves a game, clients are now able to save the sequence.
[*] [Multiplayer] When the host leaves a game, the results screen shows that they lost and remaining players are winners.
[*] [Multiplayer] Fixed multiplayer game not starting if clients disconnect in specific order before game starts.
[*] [Multiplayer] Fixed the refresh button in the multiplayer lobby so players no longer have to press it twice.[/list]

[h1]Sequence-file Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] [Sequence] Fixed grass and water flickering after restarting a sequence.
[*] [Sequence] Fixed additional object leaks when restarting sequences.
[*] [Sequence] Fixed issue with the save sequence always displaying ‘Normal’ difficulty
[*] [Sequence] Fixed screen transitions when trying to load a corrupt game or sequence save.
[*] [Sequence] Fixed sequence replay pause state being saved + loaded.[/list]

[h1]Additions/Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] Updated engine version to Unreal 4.24.
[*] Added backspace functionality allow reversion to previously selected unit.
[*] Matchmaking screen now shows servers that are active and full in the list but does not make them joinable. 
[*] Updated localized strings to fix some text issues.
[*] Code now checks whether a game or sequence save succeeded before saving the associated meta data to the primary profile save.
[*] Changed error name when trying to join a full game session.[/list]

notes.title: First update (v1.02) of Praetorians - HD Remaster released
notes.content:
Legionnaires,

Thank you for all your feedback thus far. We’ve been hard at work on the very first patch (v.1.02) for Praetorians - HD Remaster, and we’re excited to share the details with you below:

Praetorians - HD Remaster Patch v1.02

Fixed:
● Fixed bug which had HUD message spam after player left multiplayer session
● Fixed tooltip on the command scroll when highlighting a village
● Fixed issue where player is unable to invite friends to a private multiplayer session
● Fixed issue where action icons don't display as activated
● Fixed issue where the icons for Archers conflict with those for Spearmen
● Fixed active mouse-wheel issue that would occur while hovering over the command scroll
● Optimized wave effect for improved framerate
● Fixed crash that would occur when holding shift and issuing a patrol order
● Fixed crash when hunters ambush mirage unit
● Fixed general localization bugs
Added:
● Added tooltip when hovering over multi-troop selection health bars
● Added tooltip when unable to train a troop
● Added ping display to multiplayer lobby
● Added pausing the game whilst Steam and/or GoG overlay are active

Please feel free to continue sending your feedback. Every message helps us pinpoint things that need to be addressed and ultimately, goes toward making the game be the best it can be.

Thanks again for your support!

Torus Games x Kalypso Media

notes.title: Commandos 2 & Praetorians HD Remasters Out Now On PC
notes.content:
Strategy publisher Kalypso Media and developers Yippee! Entertainment and Torus Games today launched [b]Commandos 2 – HD Remaster[/b] and [b]Praetorians – HD Remaster[/b]. The games can now be purchased individually on Steam (Commandos 2/Praetorians). 
Each title contains a full high-definition refurbishment of its Pyro Studios precursor whilst adding revamped tutorials and campaign missions, controller support, as well as an integrated version of Praetorians – HD Remaster’s multiplayer mode.

The console versions of [b]Commandos 2 – HD Remaster[/b] and [b]Praetorians – HD Remaster[/b] are set to launch in Spring 2020. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1MxSnglPBgA&feature=youtu.be


[b]Information[/b]
[b]Title:[/b] Praetorians – HD Remaster
[b]Platforms:[/b] Windows PC, PlayStation®4, Xbox One
[b]Developer:[/b] Torus Games
[b]Genre:[/b] Real-time Tactics
[b]Release:[/b] Out now (Windows PC) 
[i]Spring 2020 (PlayStation®4, Xbox One)[/i]
[b]Hashtag:[/b] #PraetoriansHDR

[b]In Praetorians – HD Remaster[/b], relive the celebrated real-time strategy classic in high definition. Set amidst the political machinations of an emerging Roman Empire, prove a legionnaire's worth on the battlefields of Egypt, the combat theaters of Gaul and the heart of the Empire itself in Italy, in the crusade to become Emperor. Learn to combine units and exploit enemy weaknesses to emerge victorious.
 
[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*]Demonstrate militant might with remastered tutorials, campaign and skirmish missions
[*]Play solo or head-to-head with fully integrated multiplayer
[*]Choose from three armies, each with an assortment of unique strengths and weaknesses
[*]Play through 20 campaign missions set in the combat theatres of Egypt, Gaul and Italy
[*]Utilise characters and unit types, each with unique abilities and formations
[*]Make use of varying terrain to strategically plan battles
[*]Engage in fast-paced real-time combat[/list]
